description: Upload a local file into an assignment's submission slot without submitting it. Nothing is submitted and your instructor sees nothing yet. Returns a file_id that can be submitted later through raw_canvas_request; submit_assignment_file uploads and submits in one step. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload, e.g. "C:/Users/me/essay.pdf".

name: upload_submission_file
title: Upload Submission File
